purpose: Share preview design concepts for comparison; not active production assets.
note: Generated concept mockups use canonical Thingtime logo and icon references. Production implementation should use exact canonical assets, fonts and palette rather than the rasterized approximations in these concepts.

variants.name: Editorial White
variants.prompt:
Create one polished new Thingtime invitation link-preview design, radically redesigning the card shown in reference image 1. Output only the rectangular flat share card, approximately 1200x630 (1.905:1 landscape), full bleed edge to edge, no surrounding screenshot, labels, presentation board or mock device. This is a visual design concept for a social sharing card.
Image roles: 1 is the current card for subject/copy only, with dated layout to replace; 2 is the official transparent rainbow voxel wordmark, a strict brand artwork reference; 3 is the official transparent four-block tree icon, strict geometry reference. Transparent areas in assets are not black backgrounds. Preserve the wordmark's distinctive square glyph pattern, proportions and ordered colors as closely as possible; do not typeset a substitute wordmark. Use clear Space Grotesk-like bold display typography and Hanken Grotesk-like body typography, optically aligned and beautifully spaced.
Exact headline: “You’re invited to Thingtime.” Exact supporting sentence: “Make yourself at home.” Footer text: “thingtime.com”. Do not add any other copy, labels, pills or calls to action. Headline must dominate and be readable at thumbnail size, with a balanced intentional line break. Body grouped naturally below with about 24px separation, not stranded across a giant whitespace gap. Logo and footer share consistent alignment. Outer safe space at least 56px.
Brand colors: mint #59ff9c, sky #59bdff, cyan #00b7ef, blush #ffa3b1, purple #6f3198, lime #a8e61d, yellow #ffc20e, orange #ff7e00; hotpink #ff69b4, near-black #17141b and white. Treat the brand as a contemporary imaginative social creative space.
Avoid fake browser chrome, nested rounded cards, envelopes, cartoon clipart, generic plus icons, emoji illustrations, thick strokes, glossy vector shading, gradients, heavy drop shadows, tiny metadata, competing slogans, random confetti, and early-2000s SVG-pack aesthetics. Use precision, editorial hierarchy and deliberate geometric art.
DIRECTION 1: EDITORIAL WHITE / RAINBOW PLAYGROUND.
Warm white near-ivory canvas. Left ~60% carries the logo at the upper margin, a large dark headline below, grouped body, and quiet footer. Right ~35% is an art-directed composition of a few large solid geometric voxel fragments sampled from the wordmark: square modules, one stepped purple form and a lime tree-like negative-space motif, with generous white gaps. Arrange on a coherent square grid with calm, intentional balance; some forms may extend beyond the far right edge, but never intrude into text. Flat pristine color. The artwork should feel like bold modern brand design, not an icon illustration. Big typography and purposeful whitespace. A restrained mint/sky/purple/lime/pink palette with tiny yellow accent. One unboxed canvas.

DIRECTION 2: PINK INVITATION / BOLD GRAPHIC POSTER.
Full hotpink #ff69b4 canvas. A large softly rounded WHITE horizontal invitation panel occupies most of the card with an even 40px pink surround, almost flat, absolutely no shadow or nested panels. Panel has a confident asymmetric composition: dark bold left-aligned headline with compact supporting sentence, official rainbow logo above, small footer below, all on a strict vertical rhythm. On the right, an oversized sculptural arrangement of FLAT square modules in mint, purple and yellow, looking like playful buildable Thingtime pieces. One large purple stepped corner intersects the white panel's lower-right edge, and one mint square peeks over its upper-right edge; this intentional overlap creates depth without bevels, perspective, light effects or gradients. Keep ample clear space, crisp contours, no UI bar, no envelope. A sophisticated joyful invitation graphic. The singular white panel has 32px rounded corners at 1200px width; square brand pieces remain perfectly square.

DIRECTION 3: NIGHT GARDEN / VIBRANT MINIMAL.
Full deep ink #17141b canvas, no framing card or border. Official rainbow voxel wordmark at upper left, generously scaled. Bright off-white large bold headline on the left across two or three balanced lines, body below in soft lavender, quiet footer at lower left. Right third carries the canonical tree icon from image3, deliberately oversized as a bold flat brand sculpture: lime top/left/right squares and warm brown bottom square with exact negative-space central square, all square edges and equal modules. Give it breathing room and strict grid alignment. Around its perimeter use just two other carefully placed detached square pieces, sky blue and pink, at smaller scale. The visual impression is premium night mode with intense color punctuation and joyful Thingtime geometry. No glows, gradients, stars, clipart or decorative texture. Strong contrast, editorial scale, modern confident simplicity.
